parent.prior_observed: MG04 native models selected 6/643 source actions each; external collector selected remaining 637/643; conventional matched; no native-only task competence established

public.source: Original Farama env.reset/env.step only; no hidden map, agent pos, goal position, evaluator-provided state, answer or reward beyond selected source outcome.
public.native_objective: No caller-provided mission stage or action goal. Native DK8U/R13 internally propose from empirical positive reward or least-observed public action support.

FIT.source: Reuse frozen MG04 1664 original selected public FIT transitions and independently cold-restored memory for both; same exact physical events, no negative-only filter, no rewarded supervision

DEV.random_baseline: Uniform over original seven legal actions, no explicit source knowledge, identical original public interface and action budget; model comparison only, not a trained conventional equivalent
DEV.no_fallback: If any native actor cannot propose a legal action, record a source-negative episode and do not use external rescue. No fake env.step. A source interface failure is a fail-closed engineering block.
DEV.reward_and_terminal: Original Farama reward / terminated / truncated flags; selected action only; exactly once native feedback, independent actor checkpoints.

acceptance: Engineering source pass means original public observations, native independent actions, real selected consequences, cold restore, same replay and clear null outcomes. Science requires separate independently preregistered first-use and matching conventional resource controls and unfamiliar-family testing; this gate cannot assert general learning or native superiority.
